verdict.rationale: Offline evaluation is well documented: the `Evaluation` object pairs a `Dataset` of test examples with built-in or custom scorers, and Weave supports comparisons and regression detection. The curation half is thin. The only link between production traces and evaluation is a marketing claim that you can test models against production traces; no documented workflow turns selected traces into a versioned Dataset. Missing for 10: documented trace-to-dataset curation (selecting, filtering or exporting production calls into a Dataset), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
